title: Overlap can hide a drying face
hook: Which layout exposes more cloth area?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Overlap hides the contacting regions from surrounding air. Separating the illustrated sheets restores those regions, although the total amount of cloth stays the same.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.
objective: Overlap hides the contacting regions from surrounding air. Separating the illustrated sheets restores those regions, although the total amount of cloth stays the same.

claims.text: Real draping and edge exposure differ; no universal time saving is claimed.
